shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin rallied towards $65,000 on July 10th, up 15% since July 1st.
Circle received US approval to become a crypto trust bank, a key regulatory milestone.
Bitcoin ETFs experienced robust weekly inflows, exceeding $1.3 billion.
Federal Reserve Chair noted receding inflation risks, easing rate hike fears for crypto.
Renewed US-Iran tensions are causing oil price volatility and broader market uncertainty.
